maml:description.maml:para: Converts uri filter parameters

The ConvertTo-AuvikQueryString cmdlet converts & formats uri filter parameters from a function which are later used to make the full resource uri for an API call
This is an internal helper function that ties in directly with the Invoke-AuvikRequest function & any public functions that define parameters
The following values are converted to the format the Auvik API expects: - Arrays are sent as a comma delimited list - Booleans are sent as true or false - Dates are sent in UTC as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ (fromDate & thruDate as YYYY-MM-DD)
Defines the short resource uri (url) to use when creating the API call
